QuestInfo.name: [It's Freezing!] Food Keeps You Warm
QuestInfo.1: Brr! It can't get any colder than this...can it? You need some food or something to keep yourself warm, and the Maple Administrator can help. Bring her #b10 Nutritious Drumsticks#k to receive some healthy help.
QuestInfo.2: You brought #b10 Nutritious Drumsticks#k to the Maple Administrator for some help with the freezing winter weather. In return, you received a title and a buff that makes your body healthier.

I'll g-give you something really good f-for your health if you do, #h0#.
